[[File:Gulzar.png|thumb|250px|Gulzar]] '''Gulzar''' (Japanese: '''ジュンジ''' ''Junji'') is a [[character of the day]] who appeared in ''[[EP107|Pokémon Food Fight!]]''. He appeared on [[Butwal Island]], when {{Tracey}} tried to pull his flower hat off his head, thinking that they were just flowers growing in the ground. Gulzar was infuriated and said that he is the greatest {{type|Grass}} {{pkmn|Trainer}} in the [[Orange Islands]]. However, {{Ash}} defended Tracey; angered by this, he challenged Ash to a {{pkmn|battle}}. After Gulzar sent out his {{p|Gloom}}, Ash tried to send out his {{AP|Charizard}}, but ended up accidentally sending out {{AP|Squirtle}} instead, followed by {{AP|Snorlax}}. However, Snorlax's {{i|Poké Ball}} broke, forcing Ash to use it in the battle. When Snorlax woke up, it tried to eat Gulzar's Gloom, and then it ate Gulzar's flower hat and his lunch. Gulzar ran away, but reappeared when Ash and {{ashfr}} were trying to go to the [[Pokémon Center]] of the island to get Snorlax's Poké Ball fixed. However, {{TRT}} tried to steal the {{pkmn|food}} supply at the Center. After Ash and Snorlax defeated [[Team Rocket]], Gulzar realized that Ash was a strong Trainer, and gained respect for him. ==Pokémon== {{MissingInfo|1|enva}} {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Gulzar |pkmn=Gloom |type1=Grass |type2=Poison |img=Gulzar Gloom.png |epnum=EP107 |epname=Pokémon Food Fight! |vajp=Kaori Tsuji |vaen= |desc=Gulzar's {{p|Gloom}} first appeared in a battle against {{Ash}}, who intended to battle it with {{AP|Charizard}} but grabbed {{AP|Squirtle}}'s {{i|Poké Ball}} by mistake. Squirtle went for a {{m|Water Gun}} but it only refreshed Gloom, so Ash recalled it and tried to send out Charizard again, but wound up sending out his {{AP|Snorlax}} instead, breaking its Poké Ball in the process. Snorlax fell asleep and Gloom used {{m|Solar Beam}}, which woke Snorlax up. It attempted to eat Gloom and Gloom had to be recalled. Gloom's only known move is {{m|Solar Beam}}.}} ==Voice actors== {{vatable|color={{grass color}}|bordercolor={{grass color light}} |ja=伊倉一恵 ''Kazue Ikura'' |en=[[Amy Birnbaum]] |ar=إيمان بيطار ''Iman Bitar'' |fr_eu=Baptiste Hupin |it=Patrizia Mottola |he=יפה גבאי ''Yafa Gabay'' |es_eu=Sara Vivas |pt_br=Rodrigo Andreatto |pl=Artur Krajewski}}
